post.linkedin_text:
How to get more Google reviews? Make it easy, and ask at the right moment.

Most businesses don't have a review problem. They have an asking problem. Here's what actually works.

Before someone calls you, they look at your star rating, how many reviews you have and two or three recent comments. If that looks thin or old, they just tap the next business on the map.

So here are the 3 things I'd do first:

1. Use Google's own review link and QR code
It's free, inside your Business Profile. Open it, go to Read reviews, then Get more reviews. Copy the link. The QR code can only be saved from a computer browser, so do it once on a laptop and print it for the counter.

2. Ask right after a good experience
For a salon, that's when the customer is looking in the mirror. Ask in person, keep it short, and send the link on WhatsApp the same day. If you wait a week, most people forget.

3. Ask everyone, and never pay for reviews
Asking only happy customers is against Google's rules. Offering a discount or freebie for a review can get those reviews removed.

And reply to every review. It shows new customers a real person runs the business.

Swipe through the steps 👇

Which one are you skipping right now: 1, 2 or 3?

#DigitalMarketing #GoogleReviews #SmallBusiness
